Notion AI alternatives

Notion AI: Writing, search and meeting notes across your whole Notion workspace. If it isn't quite right, here are 14 other AI productivity tools from Radar, in Radar's order.

  1. 1GammaPresentations, documents and simple sites, designed for you from an outline.Free plan
  2. 2GranolaMeeting notes without a bot joining the call, your notes, filled in by AI.Free plan
  3. 3OtterLive transcripts and summaries of meetings and lectures.Free plan
  4. 4FathomRecords, transcribes and summarises your video calls, free for one person.Free plan
  5. 5FirefliesA meeting assistant that records, transcribes and searches your calls.Free plan
  6. 6RaycastA launcher for your computer with AI chat and commands a keystroke away.Free plan
  7. 7SuperhumanVery fast email, with AI that writes replies and sorts what matters.Paid
  8. 8ReclaimFinds time in your calendar for tasks, habits and focus, and defends it.Free plan
  9. 9MotionPlans your day from your tasks and meetings, and replans when things move.Paid
  10. 10GleanSearch and an assistant across all of a company's apps and documents.Paid
  11. 11Microsoft 365 CopilotCopilot in Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint and Teams, grounded in your work.Paid
  12. 12Zoom AI CompanionMeeting summaries, catch-ups and drafted follow-ups inside Zoom.Paid
  13. 13tl;dvRecords and summarises Zoom, Meet and Teams calls.Free plan
  14. 14Read AIMeeting reports, plus a digest of your email and messages.Free plan

Free to start: Gamma, Granola, Otter.
